scope: Extract protocol, tools, recovery, control, observation

findings.title: Conditional handoff limits missing from model-facing contract
findings.recommendation: Share scoped mechanical requirements between schema descriptions, dynamic prompt, diagnostics and local gate; retain approve-only P2/P3/P4 predicate and 1200 characters / 20 nonempty lines.
findings.cost: small; provider schema enforcement is conditional on verified keyword support
findings.migration: Future requirements/diagnostics only; retain historical receipts and original frozen semantic rules

findings.title: Make same-path implementation/host binding obligations explicit
findings.recommendation: Expose category to binding_key/path/symbol mapping; report expected locator; explicitly allow model-authored duplicate anchors across categories.
findings.boundary: Current machine gate verifies category/path, not semantic support or AST symbol range.
findings.cost: small; no evidence protocol upgrade or C++ parser
findings.migration: Existing fixed bindings projected more clearly; no automatic recategorization or retroactive evidence edits

findings.title: Keep strict evidence selection while returning exact coordinate/index facts
findings.recommendation: Report JSON pointer, actual file/range size, offset units and index bounds; preserve original array positions and complete revalidation.
do_not: Claim arbitrary evidence-helper execution is currently granted
findings.migration: No raw/receipt rewriting; old selection errors remain historical

findings.title: Accumulate independent mechanical diagnostics and preserve schema error detail
findings.recommendation: Run identity/safety prerequisites first, then collect independently decidable shape/coordinate/obligation/count errors in one shared validator; propagate structured details into existing feedback.
findings.cost: medium local refactor; delete duplicate shape semantics and generic first-error-only messages
findings.migration: Add diagnostic details to future machine records; preserve hard rejection categories and original history

findings.title: Replace lifetime receipt-repair stop with existing scope call budget
findings.recommendation: For ordinary safely recoverable receipt repairs, use call_exhaustion as the automatic bound; preserve lifetime counters and reserved independent review/adjudication/signoff calls.
findings.boundary: Do not extend CLI failures, maintenance, single-decision operations, identity/permission/source failures or unknown termination; no old run is resumed automatically.
findings.cost: small code change, meaningful product default tradeoff
findings.user_decision: Recommended default is the already-authorized scope call budget; an additional lower automation cap is only needed if explicitly requested, not as per-resume approval.
findings.migration: Never reset used repair/call counts; old frozen runs retain their executor until authorized tools-only binding

findings.title: Keep artifact rules, normalization provenance and semantic responsibility separate
findings.recommendation: Preserve first-draft Version, links, text budgets and read-only providers. Improve warning location/actionability without granting P3 upstream writes or requiring every warning to be manually removed.
findings.cost: small Extract clarification; Template semantic fixes owned by schema audit
findings.migration: Do not renormalize or rewrite published raw bytes

findings.title: Retain scoped recovery and tools-only progress-preserving continuation
findings.recommendation: Keep exact failure/source/authority checks, preserved drafts/approvals/counters, healthy siblings and audit markers. Fix reporting in X-08 instead of inventing a recovery layer.
findings.migration: User-approved tools-only continuation remains valid; no source/task/semantic migration and no published-run repair

findings.title: CLI can report committed=false after a durable control authorization

observed_reproduction.method: Real cli.main and monitor.request_restart; MemoryStore transaction copy/commit; patched static preflight and start_background raising SupervisorBusy after retry registration

findings.recommendation: Track/report existing request and launch commit boundaries; post-registration busy returns committed plus pending/unknown delivery. Unknown top-level boundaries must not default to false.
findings.cost: medium across existing multi-step control entrypoints; no new ledger
findings.migration: Future control replies only; do not reinterpret the verified uncommitted FMHA event as a duplicate-call incident

findings.title: Cache stale status is reused for a fresh authoritative-state fallback
recap_items: 状态时效与旧到期记录
findings.recommendation: Separate cache_status from returned observation source/freshness; verify stable state read, preserve read-only behavior and deep_verified=false.
findings.cost: small; no background cache repair or resume
findings.migration: Add observation metadata; do not rewrite old state/summary or remove ctime protection without evidence

findings.title: Superseded rows still contribute top-level current anomalies
recap_items: 状态时效与旧到期记录
findings.recommendation: Keep original sampled rows but exclude superseded samples from actionable aggregate counts and print their historical status before advice.
findings.migration: No state-authority change; preserve latest protection and historical samples

findings.title: New explicit monitor generation inherits old due time and scan number
recap_items: 状态时效与旧到期记录
findings.recommendation: Fresh initial scan and due schedule after explicit stop/start; preserve exact due/reminder identity for enabled same-generation daemon recovery.
findings.migration: Future explicit generation changes only; retain history, queue ownership and old-generation acknowledgement rejection; do not start current stopped monitor

findings.title: Placeholder directories and unknown-model warning are not extraction defects
findings.recommendation: Document nonexistent output leaf and verified-empty placeholder cleanup; keep no-replace publication and requested/reported model separation.
findings.migration: No automatic directory deletion, model replacement, or capability claim

findings.title: Read machine output according to existing shapes and settlement boundaries
findings.recommendation: Document JSON flags, digest-valued accepted_receipts, proposal/receipt mapping and settled usage; expose already-recorded failure/repair counters in lightweight scope summaries.
findings.cost: small; avoid generic adapters and a second audit/recovery API
findings.migration: Additive summary fields; no absent-usage zero filling or retroactive record rewriting

findings.title: Kernel defects and source proof gaps excluded from implementation scope
recap_items: 已发现但本轮没有修复的来源风险与观察
findings.recommendation: Retain source risks, user performance exceptions and limitations; route any schema misrepresentation to SCHEMA_AUDIT rather than kernel repair.
findings.migration: No kernel edits, invented GPU verification, or published-byte rewrite

findings.title: P2 reviewer revise empty plan produces false candidate diagnostics

observed_reproduction.both_check_diagnostic: P2 selection requires root and at most 10 designs including root

findings.recommendation: Check the read worker plan_draft for P2 revise; retain approve equality checks. Mark first-P2 instances pending/current draft rather than removed before any installed selection.
findings.boundary: The candidate's alleged approved-selection rollback was not confirmed; plan_draft was retained and no P2 approval had yet been installed.
findings.migration: Correct future diagnostics and material tags; preserve historical checks, counters and receipts with audit explanation

not_performed: independent semantic approval of all 33 delivered designs
investigation proving the operating-system cause of KDA ctime change
